mapper.select: select id, tag_id, batch_id, tag_type, tag_rule, stat_start_time, stat_end_time, status, create_time, update_time from crowd_tags_job where tag_id = #{tagId} and batch_id = #{batchId} limit 1

select t.id, t.tag_id, t.tag_name, t.tag_desc, t.statistics, t.create_time, t.update_time, j.batch_id as latest_batch_id, j.status as latest_job_status from crowd_tags t left join crowd_tags_job j on j.id = ( select max(j2.id) from crowd_tags_job j2 where j2.tag_id = t.tag_id ) order by t.id desc limit #{limit}
select id, tag_id, batch_id, tag_type, tag_rule, stat_start_time, stat_end_time, status, create_time, update_time from crowd_tags_job where status = 0 order by id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into crowd_tags_detail ( tag_id, user_id, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{tagId}, #{userId}, now(), now() ) on duplicate key update update_time = now()
mapper.update: update crowd_tags set statistics = #{statistics}, update_time = now() where tag_id = #{tagId}
